claims.summary: A short-lived setup receipt restores the course brief and intended safe action across stale lazy-route refreshes without persisting private attachment bytes.
Course-map Review and Check starters route to the deterministic local package audit instead of advisory model acknowledgment.
The ribbon labels aggregate progress as Overall and the voice pass skips impossible-at-ceiling provider work with a recorded receipt.
Valid Scion setup, update recovery, and AI-draft disclosure use informational or neutral language while amber remains reserved for attention.
Preset and lesson selectors expose pressed truth, and the quality report exposes labeled modal semantics plus Escape close behavior.
The 390 by 844 setup flow keeps its CTA and attachment guidance legible with no horizontal document overflow.
The repaired release candidate passes focused regression coverage, the complete suite, lint, build, and a hash-bound desktop-and-phone replay.
No adapter or Gemma weight changes; V0.16.51 is a compiler, orchestration, accessibility, efficiency, and workflow-trust release.
